name: Paz Palace
scope: The standing Palacio Paz residence enclosing its light court and the attached low avenue entrance, with the main façade, side bow window and French roof pavilions.
era: Present historic residence with the surviving 1914 envelope documented shortly after construction.

originalReview.notes: The original exterior photograph from the June 1916 issue of Plus Ultra matches the exact June issue’s full page in the Ibero-American Institute catalogue. It shows the two street elevations, mansard, dormers, chamfered corner, bow window and central pavilion.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the published Qualla media. Its two public-domain files depict other Buenos Aires subjects. The exact published June 1916 exterior was verified with the original photographic plate and the independent periodical archive leaf.
